title: Censure motion against Education Minister Seki rejected by ruling party majority, Prime Minister Takaichi intends to keep him in office
summary: The censure motion against Education Minister Seki submitted to the plenary session of the House of Councillors was voted down by a majority, and the Prime Minister indicated her stance to keep the cabinet minister in office.

title: JAXA announces first astronaut recruitment in 5 years for lunar exploration 'Artemis program'
summary: Aiming for generational change and human resource expansion looking ahead to lunar exploration, a small number of candidates will be recruited regardless of educational background or specialization.

title: Takenori Kanzaki, former leader of Komeito, passes away at 83, having contributed to building the framework of the LDP-Komeito coalition government
summary: The politician who decided to participate in the coalition government and supported successive LDP prime ministers has closed his life.

title: Toyota Motor postpones EV battery plant project in Fukuoka Prefecture once again due to sluggish EV demand
summary: Amid uncertainty in electric vehicle demand and market trends, the construction schedule has been postponed for the third time.

title: 40-year-old woman arrested on suspicion of illegal resale of diabetes treatment Mounjaro prescribed under welfare system
summary: She is suspected of abusing the publicly funded system to obtain the drug and selling it through social media to make a profit.
